info.title: Northstar API contract
info.description: Route/auth inventory, POST fields and structured success-response schemas for all current API operations. Runtime English, semantic, provenance and conditional identity policies remain authoritative. Legacy editorial calls require reviewer/actor fields; individual authentication supplies them. JSON POST bodies are bounded to 12000 bytes. Static assets excluded.
